fields.Name: Scarab Right Lane Arc
fields.ScriptBody:
local p = progress

local lane = -1
local laneWidth = math.max(1.2, startDistance * 0.09)
local snakeWidth = math.max(0.35, startDistance * 0.025)
local snakeArc = math.max(0.32, startDistance * 0.032)
local snakeWaves = 1.35

local startDrop = math.max(0.5544, startDistance * 0.04032)
local chestLift = math.max(0.30, startDistance * 0.022)
local endLower = math.max(1.15, startDistance * 0.085)
local chestOffset = 0.35

local curve = sin(p * 180)

local rise = 0
if (p > 0.60) then
  rise = (p - 0.60) / 0.40
  rise = rise * rise
end

local lateArcP = 0
if (p > 0.20) then
  lateArcP = (p - 0.20) / 0.80
end

local lateArc = (lateArcP * lateArcP) * (1 - lateArcP) * 4
local dip = -startDrop * ((1 - p) * (1 - p))
local terminalDrop = endLower * (p * p * p)

local snake = sin(p * 360 * snakeWaves)
transRight = (lane * laneWidth * curve) + (lane * snakeWidth * snake * curve)
transUp = dip + (lateArc * snakeArc) + (rise * chestLift) - terminalDrop - (chestOffset * p * p)

speedScalar = 1.0
faceImpactPos = 1
